name: Word NYC: Live Music Tonight
subtitle: Tonight's music on a map
promotionalText: Tonight's live music in New York on one map: jazz clubs, indie rooms, the Met and Carnegie Hall. Updated every morning, with a noon pick of the best shows.
description:
Word NYC shows you what's playing in New York tonight, on one live map.

Every morning at 5 AM, Word NYC reads the calendars of more than 150 venues, from Village Vanguard, Smalls and Blue Note to Carnegie Hall, the Met, Roulette, Bowery Ballroom and Brooklyn Steel, and puts tonight's shows on a map. Gold pins are playing right now, so you can see at a glance where the music is.

WHAT'S ON, RIGHT NOW
• Every show tonight on a map of the city, with what's live, starting soon and later
• Set times, performers, program and ticket prices
• Filter by jazz, classical, opera, dance, indie, rock, Latin, electronic and more
• Tap a show for details, tickets and directions in Apple Maps

TONIGHT'S PICKS AT NOON
Turn on one notification a day, at noon, with a few of the night's best shows. Follow the venues you love with the heart, and the noon pick tells you when they have a show tonight. Turn it off any time.

MADE FOR GOING OUT
• Works on the subway: the app keeps tonight's lineup on your phone
• Share a show, or a story-ready image of tonight's map, to Instagram and Messages
• No account, no sign-up, no ads

Word NYC lists shows; it doesn't sell tickets. "Get tickets" opens the venue's or ticket seller's own page. Some ticket links earn Word NYC a commission at no extra cost to you, and venues can pay to feature a show, which is always labeled Sponsored.

Venues change their plans, so check the venue's own listing before you go. Missing a show? Tell us from the app.
reviewNotes:
Word NYC is a guide to tonight's live music in New York City. A new lineup of 100+ shows from 150+ venues is built every morning; the app shows it on a map and a list that update through the night (live / starting soon / later).

Native features in this build:
• Push notifications: an opt-in "Tonight's picks" notification once a day at noon (tap "Turn on" under the list). Tapping the notification opens that show's details. It can be turned off inside the app (link at the bottom of the list) or in Settings.
• Follow venues: tap the heart on a show's details or on a venue page. Followed venues are saved on the device, marked in the list, and mentioned in the noon notification when they have a show.
• Offline: the app keeps the latest lineup on the device and lists it when there's no connection.
• iOS share sheet for shows and for a story image of tonight's map; Apple Maps for directions; haptics.

Tickets: Word NYC doesn't sell anything. "Get tickets" opens the venue's or ticket seller's own page in Safari's in-app view, to buy tickets for real-world concerts (guideline 3.1.3(e) / 3.1.5). Some of these links are affiliate links, disclosed under the button ("may earn a commission").

Sponsored listings: venues pay Word NYC directly (outside the app) to feature a show. Featured shows and notifications are always labeled "Sponsored". The notification opt-in text says it may be led by a sponsored show.

No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.
